name: and
example: if age >= 18 and has_id then\n    print("allowed")\nend
doc: Logical AND: true only if both sides are true. Short-circuits -- b isn't evaluated if a is already false.

name: as
doc: Gives an imported module a local alias to refer to it by.

name: async
example:
async func fetch_data()
    result = await http_get(url)
    return result
end
doc: Declares a function as asynchronous. Its body may use await to suspend until another async call finishes.

name: await
example: async func main()\n    data = await fetch_data()\nend
doc: Suspends the current async function until expr (typically a call to another async function) completes, then yields its result. Only valid inside an async func.

name: base
example:
class Dog : Animal
    func Dog(name)
        base(name)
    end
end
doc: Inside a subclass, calls the superclass's constructor or method with args.

name: break
example:
for n in range(10) then
    if n == 5 then
        break
    end
    print(n)
end
doc: Exits the innermost while or for loop immediately.

name: case
syntax:
select expr
    case item, item, ... then
        ...
end
example:
select day
    case "sat", "sun" then
        print("weekend")
end
doc: One branch of a select. Each item can be a plain value (equality), "a to b" (inclusive range), or "is <op> value" (relational). Multiple items can be comma-separated; the branch runs if any of them match.

name: catch
doc: Handles an exception raised inside the try block above it, binding it to e. Parentheses around e are optional.

name: class
example:
class Animal
    func speak()
        print("...")
    end
end

class Dog : Animal
    func speak()
        print("Woof!")
    end
end
doc: Declares a class. : Base is optional and gives it a single superclass.

name: continue
example:
for n in range(5) then
    if n == 2 then
        continue
    end
    print(n)
end
doc: Skips straight to the next iteration of the innermost while or for loop.

name: elif
example:
if score >= 90 then
    print("A")
elif score >= 80 then
    print("B")
else
    print("C")
end
doc: Adds another condition to an if statement, checked only if the ones above it were false. Optional, and there can be more than one.

name: else
example:
if is_raining then
    print("bring an umbrella")
else
    print("enjoy the sun")
end
doc: Runs when none of the if/elif conditions above it were true. Optional, and must be the last clause before end.

name: end
syntax: if / while / for / func / class / try\n    ...\nend
doc: Closes the block started by if, while, for, func, class, or try. Every one of those needs a matching end.

name: extern
example: extern "mylib" as Native\n    func Add(a, b)\nend
doc: Declares functions implemented by a native library, resolved at runtime against the given alias. Only declarations go inside -- no bodies.

name: finally
example:
try
    open_file()
finally
    close_file()
end
doc: Runs after the try block, whether or not an exception was raised or caught.

name: for
example: for name in ["Ana", "Luis", "Sol"] then\n    print(name)\nend
doc: Iterates item over iterable (a list, a range(...), etc.), running the block once per element. Needs then before the body, like if.

name: func
example:
func greet(name)
    print("Hello, " + name)
end

greet("Ava")
doc: Declares a named function, or -- used as an expression, without a name -- an anonymous one. (params) => expr is the short single-expression form.

name: if
example:
if age >= 18 then
    print("adult")
else
    print("minor")
end
doc: Runs the first block whose condition is true. elif and else are optional; the block always closes with end.

name: import
syntax: import module|||import module.submodule|||import module as alias
example: import utils.math as m\nprint(m.square(4))
doc: Loads another AvaLang file by module path and makes its top-level names available, optionally under alias.

name: in
doc: Pairs with for to name what's being iterated over.

name: is
example: case is >= 60 then\n    print("passing")
doc: Inside a select's case, compares the select's value against value using compOp (==, !=, <, <=, >, >=).

name: local
example:
x = 10
func change()
    local x = 20
    print(x)
end
doc: Declares name as a new local variable in the current scope, instead of assigning to an existing outer/global one of the same name.

name: not
example: if not is_valid then\n    print("invalid")\nend
doc: Logical negation: true if a is false, and vice versa.

name: or
example: if is_weekend or is_holiday then\n    print("no work today")\nend
doc: Logical OR: true if either side is true. Short-circuits -- b isn't evaluated if a is already true.

name: pass
example: if user.is_admin then\n    pass\nend
doc: Does nothing. Useful as a placeholder body while a block is still empty, since AvaLang has no truly empty block.

name: private
example:
class Account
    private func validate()
        ...
    end
end
doc: Marks a class member as private, restricting access from outside the class. Can combine with static (static private func ...).

name: raise
example: if amount < 0 then\n    raise "amount can't be negative"\nend
doc: Raises value as an exception, unwinding until a matching catch handles it (or the program stops if none does).

name: return
example: func double(n)\n    return n * 2\nend
doc: Exits the current function immediately, optionally handing back value. With no value, the function returns nil.

name: select
syntax:
select expr
    case value1, value2 then
        ...
    case a to b then
        ...
    case is compOp value then
        ...
    else
        ...
end
example:
select grade
    case 90 to 100 then
        print("A")
    case is >= 80 then
        print("B")
    else
        print("F")
end
doc: Compares expr against each case in order and runs the first match. Closes with a single end (no end select, no case else -- use else like if).

name: static
example:
class Counter
    static func create()
        return Counter()
    end
end
doc: Marks a class method as static, callable on the class itself rather than on an instance. Can combine with private (static private func ...).

name: then
doc: Starts the body of an if or elif clause. Always follows the condition, never stands on its own.

name: to
example: case 1 to 10 then\n    print("single digit")
doc: Inside a select's case, matches when the select's value falls between a and b inclusive.

name: try
example:
try
    risky_call()
catch (e)
    print("Error: " + str(e))
end
doc: Runs the block, routing any raised exception to a catch clause. At least one catch or a finally is required.

name: while
example:
count = 0
while count < 5
    print(count)
    count = count + 1
end
doc: Repeats the block for as long as condition stays true. Parentheses around the condition are optional.

name: yield
example:
func counter()
    n = 0
    while true
        yield n
        n = n + 1
    end
end
doc: Pauses the current function and hands value back to its caller, turning it into a coroutine/generator that can be resumed later.
